title: Reserve each generated method name separately
summary: Reserving two generated method names now produces apply1 and test1. A peer reserved one name at a time and returned the same four names, including the free applyTest spelling.

change.description: An AOT contribution can reserve several interface method names in one call. The parent combines the arguments into a single suggested name while checking the first reservation.

notes: Both callers obtained a fresh GeneratedClass through DefaultGenerationContext. The parent threw while reserving the pair.
